SpaMediaImage.description: Metadata for an uploaded spa image stored in S3

objectKey.description: S3 object key for the image

title.description: Human friendly title for the image

SpaMediaVideo.description: Metadata for an uploaded spa video stored in S3

objectKey.description: S3 object key for the video

SpaRequest.description: Spa profile payload used for onboarding and updates.

description.description: Description that appears in discovery pages
description.example: Boutique spa with steam and sauna

openTimeLocal.description: Opening time in spa's local timezone

closeTimeLocal.description: Closing time in spa's local timezone

therapistTypesAvailable.description: Therapist types available at the spa

therapistIds.description: Therapist identifiers to associate with the spa

serviceIds.description: Service identifiers offered at the spa

images.description: Uploaded image metadata for the spa

videos.description: Uploaded video metadata for the spa

active.description: Whether spa is active for booking

featured.description: Whether spa should be highlighted in discovery

version.description: Version for optimistic locking during updates

SpaResponse.description: Detailed representation of a spa after creation or update

images.description: Images attached to the spa profile

videos.description: Videos attached to the spa profile

therapistIds.description: Therapist identifiers linked to the spa

serviceIds.description: Service identifiers offered by the spa

BuySpaPackageRequest.description: Payload to purchase a spa-specific package.

spaId.description: Spa identifier where package is being purchased

paymentReference.description: Reference or transaction id from payment gateway

ApiError.description: Standardized error payload returned for failed requests.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the error was generated

path.description: Request path that resulted in the error

FieldErrorDetails.description: Validation error details for a specific field

message.example: must be a well-formed email address

SpaMediaAttachRequest.description: Metadata used to attach an uploaded S3 object to a spa

objectKey.description: Object key already uploaded to S3

MediaAssetResponse.description: Metadata for a media asset associated with a spa

id.description: Database identifier for the media asset

MediaPresignRequest.description: Request to generate a pre-signed S3 upload URL for spa media

spaId.description: Spa identifier the media belongs to

MediaPresignResponse.description: Response containing S3 pre-signed upload information

uploadUrl.description: Pre-signed PUT URL to upload directly to S3

objectKey.description: Object key that was reserved for the upload

expiresAt.description: Timestamp when the signed URL expires

BookingCreateRequest.description: Payload to create a booking for a spa service.

spaId.description: Spa identifier where booking is being created

guests.description: Number of guests included in booking

specialRequest.description: Special request notes for the spa

redeemLoyaltyPoints.description: Whether loyalty points should be redeemed

holdToken.description: Hold token for reserved slot if applicable

payWithPackage.description: Whether to consume an available package instead of direct payment

bookingSource.description: Source of booking traffic for analytics

BookingRescheduleRequest.description: Payload to reschedule an existing booking.

targetSlotId.description: New slot identifier the booking should move to

allowSameDayChange.description: Allow rescheduling within same day even if cut-off applies

UserRegistrationRequest.description: Payload for registering a new Nirvana user account.

consentSource.description: Channel through which consent was recorded

AuthResponse.description: Authentication payload containing JWT token and user profile data.

refreshToken.description: Refresh token used to rotate sessions without re-login

username.description: Username or email for the authenticated user

mfaRequired.description: True when an additional MFA challenge is required for sensitive actions

mfaVerificationId.description: Verification id used to complete an MFA or OTP login challenge

deviceFingerprint.description: Opaque device fingerprint to bind the refresh token to a browser/device

SocialLoginRequest.description: Request to initiate social OAuth2 login

redirectUri.description: Optional redirect URI to use after provider authentication

deviceFingerprint.description: Device fingerprint to revoke all sessions for a device

LoginRequest.description: Credentials used to authenticate a user.
